description: Mixed-language text — Chinese/English, Chinese/number, Chinese + formula. The segmenter auto-detects the region type, and the dispatcher routes by inline node.

cases.note: 公式 (formula) + math + 等于 (equals): blanks around math region
设 (let) + math + 为 (be) + 变量 (variable)
用 (use) + math + 表示 (denote) (表=biao3: iao final is ⠜)
Chinese + CPU acronym (doubled ⠠⠠ for whole-word capitals) + Chinese

dollar_prose.description: Literal $ in prose (currency) — amounts must not pair into a formula that swallows the words between them; the $ signs themselves are unmapped punctuation and warn

cases.note: two currency amounts: each $ stays prose (blank cell + warning), 5/6 render as numbers, 梨 stays a word — the old greedy pair read $5,梨$ as one 'formula' and blanked the hanzi
a price followed by a digit-led formula: the formula still pairs (its closer is followed by a space, not a digit), and the price's $ stays prose instead of stealing the formula's opener as its close
amounts around full-width commas: both $ stay prose, both numbers survive whole
Chinese + digit + measure word + noun; a number is its own word, so 有→3 takes a word-boundary space (every hanzi but the ordinal prefix 第 does); the hyphen/connector ⠤ binds 3个 (个's leading cell ⠛=7)
